subject: SpatialKernelTuplePass per spec
description: Per docs/specs/decomposers/layer-type-library.md §ConvLayerDecomposer + §ConformerBlock conv_module. Handles ConvResidualBlock (conv1, norm1, conv2, norm2, optional shortcut) AND ConformerBlock conv_module (pointwise_conv1, depthwise_conv, batch_norm BnState, pointwise_conv2). Fires model_local_kernel_evidence on model_spatial_pattern edges between pixel_region/audio_chunk neighbors. Required for ResNet backbones, VAE, U-Net, conv-based vision, Conformer audio.
